workflows.name: validate, commit, push both branches
workflows.signature: bash scripts/*.sh ; git add -A ; git commit -q -F - ; git push -q -u origin ha-deploy ; git push -q origin ha-deploy:claude/ha-dashboard-upgrades-wui7ig
workflows.notes: the push-to-both-branches step is the one that gets forgotten

workflows.name: parse views, locate a section, splice YAML
workflows.signature: yaml.safe_load(dashboard) ; find <str> line offsets ; find <str> section starts within a view ; walk back over the leading comment block ; splice new lines into the list ; re-parse and assert the shape
steps: find '  - type: grid' section starts within a view
walk back over the leading comment block
splice new lines into the list

workflows.name: render a card across live and dark states
workflows.signature: yaml.safe_load(dashboard) ; build a HA-shaped jinja context ; render EN and CN ; render again with everything unavailable ; read the output for false reassurance
steps: read the output for false reassurance

workflows.name: structural diff of the dashboard against a git ref
workflows.signature: git show <rev>:dashboards/*.yaml ; parse both trees ; collect entities, navs, services, cards ; diff the sets

workflows.name: add a gate to dashboard_check and negative-test it
workflows.signature: write the check with a why-comment ; run ha_validate.sh ; cp dashboard to scratch ; reintroduce the defect ; confirm VALIDATION FAILED names the view ; restore and re-run
steps: write the check with a why-comment
confirm VALIDATION FAILED names the view

workflows.name: verify an entity against live before using it
workflows.signature: grep the export for the id ; GetLiveContext by domain or area ; reconcile friendly name to entity_id ; check for a duplicate twin
steps: grep the export for the id

workflows.name: obtain a screenshot of a live CasaRay view
workflows.signature: ask the owner to photograph the wall iPad ; wait for the image to be pasted into the conversation ; read the image ; guess the viewport the photo was taken at ; compare against docs/mockups by eye
steps: ask the owner to photograph the wall iPad
wait for the image to be pasted into the conversation
guess the viewport the photo was taken at
workflows.notes: blocks every visual check; cannot run without a human

workflows.name: hand-build a state set to render a card against
workflows.signature: list the entities a card references ; guess a plausible value for each ; write a throwaway JSON ; render and measure ; throw the JSON away
steps: list the entities a card references
guess a plausible value for each
workflows.notes: every such set was different, so measurements were not comparable

workflows.name: pick the next free tracking id by eye
workflows.signature: grep one document for the prefix ; guess the highest number ; write the row
steps: grep one document for the prefix

workflows.name: stamp a commit SHA into tracking rows
workflows.signature: git commit with the SHA left as a placeholder ; git rev-parse --short HEAD ; regex the new rows in LIVE_VERIFICATION_QUEUE.md ; git add -A ; bash scripts/*.sh ; git commit -m <str>
steps: git commit with the SHA left as a placeholder
regex the new rows in LIVE_VERIFICATION_QUEUE.md

workflows.name: verify a dashboard change before pushing
workflows.signature: bash scripts/*.sh ; preserve_check.py --ref HEAD ; render_cards.py --all > new.txt ; diff old.txt new.txt ; read the diff and decide

workflows.name: compare a live render against the approved mockup
workflows.signature: identify which mockup is the right baseline for the device ; read both images ; correlate each difference to a YAML cause ; decide severity and whether it is already fixed at HEAD ; assign an ID and write it up
steps: identify which mockup is the right baseline for the device
correlate each difference to a YAML cause
decide severity and whether it is already fixed at HEAD
assign an ID and write it up
